environment_provenance_gate.rule: cross-engine evidence requires complete ISA flags and one internally consistent full-CPU power policy

output_equivalence_gate.rule: every measured row needs a passing cross-engine equivalence verdict from the same input, Rust ELF and mermaid bundle (scripts/headtohead/equivalence.mjs)
output_equivalence_gate.method: svg_structural (rendered-text token containment + geometrically reconstructed edge topology); not byte equality, not a rasterized perceptual diff

median_ci_gate_rule: claim magnitude >= max(1.01, 1 + 2 * max(per-engine A/A CI radius))
fm_bracket_gate_rule: Rust pre/post drift magnitude <= max(1.01, 1 + 2 * Rust A/A CI radius)

arm_asymmetry.rule: global phase CPU busy is provenance; numeric gate uses bracketed Rust A/A

fm_bracket.reason: Rust phase drift clears its A/A median-CI floor

semantic_work.rule: both engines must receive the same positive diagram count and byte-identical input

clauses.effect_ci_note: cross-runtime ratio of two separately measured medians has no effect CI

output_equivalence.claim: engine-neutral structural equivalence: rendered-text multiset (all families) plus geometrically reconstructed edge topology cross-engine and against input-derived ground truth (node/edge families only). Not byte equality; not a pixel diff.
